verdict.rationale: Auth0 documents bulk user imports and exports for database connections, plus gradual automatic migration (docs-11, docs-46, docs-57, docs-66), so the core import/export capability is first-party. However, nothing in the evidence shows that password hashes can be included in an import. A hands-on community report says an export that includes password hashes needed a support ticket rather than self-service (comm-12), which undercuts the 'never locked in' goal. Missing for 10: documented import of password hashes (supported hash algorithms), self-service export including password hashes, independent corroboration of the round trip.
